references.text: Elteke and Gibbethon are again mentioned as Levitical cities given to the sons of Kohath from the tribe of Dan
Gibbethon is mentioned as the place where Baasha defeated Nadab, king of Israel, while he was besieging the Philistine city
Gibbethon is mentioned again in connection with Omri's revolt against Zimri, when Israel besieged the city
